note: What tshark printed while the guide in this folder was checked, on 20 November 2026, on Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS: a capture on the loopback interface of the guide's test server (shop_api.py) while traffic.sh sent ten requests. The capture is sample/web.pcapng.
capinfos:
File name:           web.pcapng
Number of packets:   120
Capture duration:    3.327373161 seconds

every_response.command: tshark -r web.pcapng -Y http.response -T fields -e frame.number -e http.response_for.uri -e http.response.code -e http.time

slow_responses.command: tshark -r web.pcapng -Y "http.response && http.time > 0.5" -T fields -e frame.number -e http.response_for.uri -e http.response.code -e http.time

slowest_first.command: tshark -r web.pcapng -Y http.response -T fields -e http.time -e http.response.code -e http.response_for.uri | sort -gr | head -5

request_frames.command: tshark -r web.pcapng -Y "http.response && http.time > 0.5" -T fields -e frame.number -e http.request_in

request_52.command: tshark -r web.pcapng -Y "frame.number == 52" -T fields -e frame.time_relative -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri -e http.user_agent
